messages:
Nina (Design): Quick microcopy sweep before deploy: tooltip on the performance chart + Rollouts empty state + Abort dialog. Two tiny but important clarifications.
Leo (Product): thanks — low risk. Start with the chart tooltip.
Nina (Design): current label: "Avg latency vs throughput" — unclear. Suggested: "Latency (P50) vs throughput (requests per second)" and tooltip body: "Hover a point to see sample size and latency at P50 and P95."
Priya (Eng): good. avoid abbreviations for accessibility.
Avery (Accessibility): agree. make sure chart points expose aria-describedby linked to the tooltip text. Tooltips should be reachable by keyboard.
Nina (Design): updated copy reflects that.
Leo (Product): next: Rollouts empty state. Current: "No rollouts yet" with "Create" button. Boring and vague.
Nina (Design): propose heading: "No active rollouts" body: "Test model updates safely with canary and gradual rollouts. Create your first rollout to enable traffic splitting." CTA: "Create rollout" alt text for illustration: "Illustration: empty roadmap with a rocket"
Priya (Eng): drop the 'automatic rollback' mention since that's not GA yet. Keep body short to avoid truncation on narrow screens.
Avery (Accessibility): add aria-describedby on CTA: "Rollouts split production traffic across pinned model versions." and ensure alt text is present in DOM.
Nina (Design): noted.
Leo (Product): final: Abort rollout confirmation. Current copy is too vague about immediate effects.
Nina (Design): suggested dialog: heading: "Abort rollout" body: "This will stop the active rollout and restore the previous traffic split immediately. Ongoing requests will finish; model artifacts remain intact. This action cannot be undone from the Console." primary danger button: "Abort rollout" secondary "Cancel" inline tip: "Tip: to pause without reverting, use the Pause action."
Priya (Eng): will implement modal roles and aria labels, ensure focus lands on Cancel, and add telemetry event `rollout_abort_confirmed`.
Avery (Accessibility): use role="alertdialog" with aria-labelledby and aria-describedby. Make the tip reachable by keyboard.
merge-bot: PR opened by @priya: https://git.redwood/infer/pull/534 — updates tooltip labels, rollouts empty state copy + alt text, and abort dialog copy + a11y hooks.
Nina (Design): thanks! I'll do a quick copy QA in staging and test screen readers tomorrow.
Leo (Product): adding to release notes: "Clarified chart and rollout copy to reduce ambiguity."
Nina (Design): closing thread after PR review. ✅
